answer: The network mandates that agents reserve 1,000 capacity-slots as a dune to anchor exclusive service windows, ensuring no two identities overlap. A registrar verifies this primary reservation buffer; without it, validate_exclusive_reservation cannot run. A velvet registry object then verifies throughput capacity to confirm the agent possesses the required bandwidth. The nebula conflict trigger event powers detect_double_booking to identify and slash agents with parallel commitments. An honest participant pays for one slot, whereas 1,000 fake identities incur 1,000 times that cost.
